text:
priya: FYI - just saw a spike of SCIM deprovision events in prod after the KMS alias rotate at 15:01 UTC. Several service accounts were deprovisioned incorrectly.

josh: Ugh. Any obvious error in the provisioner logs?

priya: Log snippet: 
```txt
provisioner ERROR 2024-04-21T15:02:03Z tenant=t-8472 http=403 KMSDecryptFailed: Failed to decrypt envelope for tenant t-8472 keyAlias=alias/redwood-prod-encrypt
stack: provisioner.decryptEnvelope -> kms.Decrypt -> AccessDeniedException
```

maria: Did the rotation change the key ARN or the alias? If alias moved, IAM policy might still reference the old ARN.

priya: The rotation replaced alias target with a new key id. IAM role for the provisioner expects kms:Decrypt on the old key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:1234/old-key-id. CloudTrail shows GenerateDataKey failed with AccessDenied for assumed role arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/provisioner-role/prov-instance.

sam: Could be the temporary role lost kms:Decrypt permission during the rotation automation. We updated the allowlist to the alias rather than key id, but the automation patched a policy to reference the key id (race).

linda: Ops-bot shows the deploy at 15:00 and a config-change at 15:01 from UID deployer-ci.ops. That matches.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: automated key rotation completed for alias "alias/redwood-prod-encrypt" -> newKeyId: 1234abcd. Canary rollout: 12/12 succeeded.

josh: For mitigation: 1) Temporarily revert alias to previous key id (if possible) 2) Re-add kms:Decrypt for provisioner-role to new key ARN 3) Backfill deprovisioned accounts using the reconciliation job. Which is safest quickly?

maria: Reverting alias is fastest but can be risky if rotation is part of CR. Re-granting kms:Decrypt to the provisioner role for new key is safest and minimal blast radius. I'll push a policy change to add the newKeyId principal.

priya: Agreed. Also need to pause the reconciliation that auto-deprovisions until we confirm. I put a hold tag on the job queue.

sam: Can you run a quick CloudTrail query for the failed kms:GenerateDataKey events so we can list impacted tenants? I can script a backfill.

maria: Running query now: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2024-04-21T14:55:00Z --end-time 2024-04-21T15:10:00Z --query 'Events[?contains(CloudTrailEvent, `provisioner-role`)]'`

priya: Found 9 tenants with AccessDenied errors. Shared the list in the incident board.

linda: Quick check - are audit logs intact? We need audit trail for compliance.

josh: Yes audit logs are fine; SCIM service writes both application-level audit and CloudTrail/KMS events. Compliance team will want signed copies. I'll export CloudTrail and app audit for those tenant ids.

priya: After Maria's policy push, provisioner logs show success for newKeyId and no further 403s. But we still need to recover the erroneously deprovisioned service accounts.

sam: Backfill plan: run reconciliation in dry-run for the 9 tenants, generate re-provision list, then run in force mode after 2ps approvals. Script attached in gist: 
```bash
# dry-run
python tools/scim_reconcile.py --tenants t-8472,t-9921 --dry-run --since 2024-04-21T14:50:00Z
# apply
python tools/scim_reconcile.py --tenants ... --apply --reason "rollback after kms rotation outage"
```

priya: Approved. Compliance: please archive the audit exports. @compliance-team will need evidence of mitigation and timeline.

maria: Follow-up action items: 1) Update rotation automation to patch IAM policies referencing aliases not key ids 2) Add KMS permission smoke test in rotation workflow 3) Add a deploy guard to pause auto-deprovisioning on key-change events. I'll open a PR.

linda: I'll file an internal incident report with timeline and attach the CloudTrail export.

josh: Nice catch Priya. :thumbsup: Let's also add an alert on repeated 403 KMSDecryptFailed from provisioner so we catch this earlier.

priya: Done. Created metric / alert (alerts#1234). Closing the thread after backfill completes.

ops-bot: reconciliation-job: hold applied to auto-deprov-queue by priya at 2024-04-21T15:12:00Z.

maria: PR up for rotation fixes: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 - includes smoke test and policy fix.

sam: Postmortem followups noted. Will run backfill tonight 02:00 UTC with minimal impact window.

priya: Thanks all.
